title: Feedback Agent (BT1608) + BT1614 Bench Spec Integration

integration_spec.bench: BT1614 SNSPD bench spec (168 bins x 2 rails)

update_rule.derivation: Information-theoretic Nyquist analog: update rate <= (1 - 2^{-S_MIN}) / n_bins

gate_integration.FAIL: click_prob < 0.80 -> emergency update + BT1606 retry flag

integration_spec.key_insight: The loop converges in ~2 cycles (1.5 hrs) because alpha_total = 1 - 2^{-S_MIN} ~ 0.762, a direct consequence of the irrep floor theorem.
